radiology_report:
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Date: 28 Jan 2025 | Facility: Tergooi MC

Clinical Indication:
Clinical suspicion of prostate malignancy accompanies a PSA reading of 14.0 ng/mL.

FINDINGS:
Prostatic tissue occupies 19.07 mL. T2 sequences highlight a 12 mm focus of hypointensity within the right anterior mid-gland peripheral zone. High b-value DWI shows intense restricted diffusion, mirrored by corresponding ADC hypointensity. DCE sequences capture prompt focal enhancement against adjacent tissue. Capsular integrity remains preserved; neurovascular bundles are spared. No seminal vesicle invasion, extraprostatic spread, suspicious nodal enlargement, or skeletal abnormalities are detected.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4
Prostate volume 19.07 mL.
PSA density 0.734 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.8159218.

previous_notes.text: Subsequent review highlights a progressive PSA trajectory, climbing from 12.0 ng/mL recorded in April 2024 to 14.0 ng/mL on recent assays. Accompanying deterioration in lower urinary tract symptoms prompted referral for expert consultation and advanced cross-sectional imaging.
